unit: Unit 6: Integration and Accumulation of Change
question:
The continuous function $f$ is defined on the closed interval $-6 ≤ x ≤ 5$. The figure above shows a portion of the graph of $f$, consisting of two line segments and a quarter of a circle centered at the point $(5, 3)$. It is known that the point $(3, 3 - sqrt(5))$ is on the graph of $f$.

(a) If $integral_{-6}^{5} f(x) dif x = 7$, find the value of $integral_{-6}^{-2} f(x) dif x$. Show the work that leads to your answer.

(b) Evaluate $integral_{3}^{5} (2 f'(x) + 4) dif x$.

(c) The function $g$ is given by $g(x) = integral_{-2}^{x} f(t) dif t$. Find the absolute maximum value of $g$ on the interval $-2 ≤ x ≤ 5$. Justify your answer.

(d) Find $lim_{x -> 1} frac{10^x - 3 f'(x)}{f(x) - arctan x}$.
